name: b2bsearch
description: Six B2B prospecting tools over the b2bsearch Actors on Apify: people search (free `count` and `market` modes), decision makers by domain, new hires, lookalike companies, email format and email by profile URL. Your own Apify token, pay per result, misses are free; a free Apify account gets 500 rows a month per Actor. Install: `npx -y @b2bsearch/mcp` · Registry: `io.github.b2bsearch/mcp`
